# task-e0c65be4: 3x3 stamp from internal markers

## Demonstrated rule
The grid contains large uniform rectangular regions of color 3 amid background 0, with scattered color-2 markers. In each contiguous color-3 rectangle, any 2 marker located inside that object's bounding box (including a marker occupying a cell within the rectangle) acts as the center of a 3×3 stamp: recolor each neighboring color-3 cell in the clipped 3×3 neighborhood to color 1. Keep the 2 markers unchanged. Leave 0 cells and all 3 cells not covered by an eligible stamp unchanged. Markers outside the objects are distractors and do not stamp. Overlapping stamps combine as a union.

For irregular objects, re-derive the object's bounds and verify against evidence rather than assuming exact full solid rectangle.

## Demonstrated rule

In each contiguous color-3 rectangle, any 2 marker located inside that object's bounding box (including a marker occupying a cell within the rectangle) acts as the center of a 3×3 stamp: recolor each neighboring color-3 cell in the clipped 3×3 neighborhood to color 1.
